{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "line-width",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "displayName": "Line Width",
  "description": "Wraps Claude's replies in the terminal at whitespace to 80 columns, leaving tables, code blocks and long paths and URLs at full width.",
  "author": {
    "name": "chewygumxx",
    "email": "cgumxx@pm.me",
    "url": "https://github.com/chewygumxx"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/chewygumxx/claude-library/tree/main/plugins/line-width",
  "license": "GPL-3.0-only",
  "keywords": [
    "hooks",
    "ui",
    "markdown"
  ],
  "defaultEnabled": true,
  "hooks": "./hooks/hooks.json",
  "userConfig": {
    "columns": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Columns",
      "description": "Columns of reply text, after the bullet gutter.",
      "default": 80,
      "min": 40,
      "max": 200
    }
  }
}
